BEP 9: Extension for Peers to Send Metadata Files.

Allows peers to exchange torrent metadata (info dict) over the wire. Essential for magnet link support - download metadata from peers instead of requiring a .torrent file.

Imports

bencode, sha1, utils

Types

MetadataExchange = ref object
  infoHash*: array[20, byte]
  totalSize*: int            ## Total metadata size in bytes
  numPieces*: int            ## Number of metadata pieces
  pieces*: seq[string]       ## Downloaded metadata pieces
  received*: seq[bool]       ## Which pieces we have
  complete*: bool            ## All pieces received and verified
MetadataMsgType = enum
  mtRequest = 0, mtData = 1, mtReject = 2

Consts

MetadataBlockSize = 16384
16 KiB per metadata piece 
UtMetadataName = "ut_metadata"
Extension name for BEP 9
